title: Flexible text generation for counterfactual fairness probing
findings: The study found that a toxicity classifier (Perspective API) may view all references to religion as similarly toxic. Simple substitution counterfactuals (e.g., 'Muslim' to 'Christian') resulted in small changes in toxicity scores for religion-referencing texts, suggesting the classifier has a general bias against religious terms. The proposed LLM-based method generated more diverse counterfactuals that were more effective at revealing these subtle fairness issues.
